name: Four Seasons Resort Rancho Encantado Santa Fe
positioning: A 65-room casita-style resort on 57 acres in the Sangre de Cristo foothills outside Santa Fe, New Mexico
best_for: Travelers who want a quiet high-desert resort with hiking, a spa and a private casita with a fireplace
Guests who want to explore Santa Fe's art scene and cultural sites from a resort base with a complimentary downtown shuttle

facts.text: The resort has 56 guest rooms and 9 suites.
The resort is set on 57 acres.
The resort is in the foothills of the Sangre de Cristo mountains.
The resort opened as a Four Seasons in July 2012.
Terra is the resort's signature restaurant.
The spa has fifteen treatment rooms.
The spa has four private soaking courtyards.
The resort has a year-round heated outdoor pool.
The resort offers a complimentary shuttle to and from downtown Santa Fe Plaza.
The resort offers complimentary valet parking to all guests.

highlights.text: Each casita features a traditional wood-burning fireplace.
The resort offers daily complimentary guided hikes along the Camino Encantado trail.
The in-casita dining menu is available 24 hours a day.
The resort has an Art Concierge Program.
All guest rooms were overhauled in a multimillion-dollar renovation in 2024.

considerations.text: Albuquerque International Sunport is a 65-minute drive from the resort.
The spa is open 9:00 am to 5:00 pm Sunday through Thursday.
WhataHotel notes the secluded location requires a drive to downtown Santa Fe.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
